test_framework: None active — SchoolManagementSystem.Application.Tests exists but contains only bin/obj (empty); no test runner to invoke
test_command: No runnable tests — verify with build only: dotnet build
verification_instructions: 1. cd to c:\Users\User\OneDrive\Desktop\SchoolManagementSystem\backend. 2. Run: dotnet build. 3. Confirm '0 Error(s)' in output. 4. Warnings from NuGet (NU1701, NU1510, NU1903, NU1902) are pre-existing — ignore them. 5. Confirm no new CS0234/CS0246/CS0118 namespace/type errors.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Persistence/Migrations/AppDbContextModelSnapshot.cs is generated by EF tooling and must NOT be moved or modified. All Migration *.cs and *.Designer.cs files similarly stay in Persistence/Migrations/.
environment_constraints: Branch: refactor/backend-structure (on origin). Git status shows untracked files only (.agents/, .kiro/, WebApi/logs/, plan.md) — no uncommitted changes to tracked files. Never push directly to main/master. Do NOT run dotnet ef migrations or regenerate migrations. Do NOT restart any dev server.
contribution_requirements: Per restructuring-plan.md: do not change business rules, validation, API routes, persistence mappings, DI lifetimes, or runtime behavior. Keep type names and public APIs unchanged except namespace declarations. Do not delete old folders/originals until user explicitly approves cleanup. Retain recoverable originals. All SDK projects use implicit file inclusion — no project-file edits needed.
key_patterns: 1. namespace declarations must match folder path relative to project root: e.g. file at Features/Auth/Entities/ → namespace SchoolManagementSystem.Domain.Features.Auth.Entities. 2. EF configurations use IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> — AppDbContext discovers them via assembly scan, so moving them is safe. 3. DependencyInjection.cs in Infrastructure is the single registration file — all using updates there are mechanical. 4. Program.cs in WebApi registers authorization handlers and maps hubs — only using updates needed, no logic changes. 5. All controller route attributes are inline on the class — namespace change does not affect routing.
directory_structure: backend/ contains: SchoolManagementSystem.Domain (flat Entities/, Enums/, Exceptions/), SchoolManagementSystem.Application (already-structured Features/<Feature>/{DTOs,Interfaces,Services}), SchoolManagementSystem.Infrastructure (flat Authentication/, Email/, Notifications/, Storage/, plus Persistence/{AppDbContext,Common,Configurations/,Migrations/,Repositories/<feature>/,Seeders/}), SchoolManagementSystem.WebApi (flat Controllers/, Authorization/, Models/, Middleware/, Program.cs)
